detail.title: Independent Judgment versus Consensus Reliability Synthesis
detail.summary: This proposal develops a provisional research notebook for proj-independent-consensus using available evidence on epistemic disagreement and peer consensus, detailing conditions under which independent judgment is warranted.

children.title: Synthesis of Independent Judgment and Consensus Reliability

detail.title: Synthesis of Independent Judgment and Consensus Reliability
detail.summary: Examines conditions under which an agent should trust its own independent reasoning versus deferring to consensus, drawing on philosophical literature regarding epistemic disagreement.
detail.reason: Synthesizes the gathered source on disagreement and consensus reliability to establish a baseline project notebook.
